summary: Make an object that reports the k-th biggest integer in a stream after sorting, where repeated values occupy separate places and the result is not the k-th distinct value. Construction reads k and the starting stream. Each later add reads one integer, places it into the stream, and writes the k-th biggest integer in the stream at that moment. k runs from 1 to 104, the starting length runs from 0 to 104, every stream integer and every newly placed value runs from -104 to 104, and add is called at most 104 times. Each query happens only when the stream already holds at least k integers.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one command per line.
